product.name: Nitro League Game Platform
product.description: A decentralized play-to-earn racing game where users race futuristic cars to earn tokens.

product.name: Nitro Tokens
product.description: Cryptographic utility tokens used within the Nitro League platform for transactions and rewards.

product.name: Car Customization and Crafting System
product.description: A system allowing players to customize and craft upgrades for their cars to enhance racing performance.

product.name: Race Modes and Competitive Features
product.description: Various race formats including live races, time trials, multiplayer, tournaments, and campaign modes for competitive play.

product.name: Land Ownership within Nitro League
product.description: A feature allowing players to buy virtual land within the Nitro League ecosystem.
